description: FOR IMMEDIATE RELEASE March 25, 2025 Steve Whisler Files for Maryland House of Delegates in District 5 Westminster, MD - Steve Whisler, a decorated Navy veteran, former educator, and elected member of the Carroll County Board of Education has officially filed his candidacy as a Republican for the Maryland House…
title: Steve Whisler Files for Maryland House of Delegates in District 5 - Whisler For Delegate
